setting: a First World War no man's land: churned gray-brown mud and craters, sandbag revetments, coils of barbed wire, shattered dead trees, a ruined farm, orchard stumps and tattered signal flags on poles, under a heavy overcast sky with soft diffuse light

subjects.desc: the player's own weapon seen in first person: a long wooden bolt-action field rifle with a fixed bayonet, a dark bolt and a leather sling, held in bare hands at the lower right of the frame
subjects.motion: locked to the viewpoint, swaying gently with each step

subjects.desc: an infantryman crossing no man's land: an enemy soldier in a gray-brown wool uniform and steel helmet rushing across the open ground with a rifle, or the one allied soldier in khaki advancing beside the player

sound: rifle cracks and distant artillery, boots in mud, wind over the craters
